index.hero_title: The security of our customers is our top priority.
index.hero_text: We help companies like yours optimize the security of their IT infrastructure. We have the necessary know-how and have already successfully helped numerous companies. If you would like to learn how to further improve security in your company, please get in touch. We look forward to helping you and finding the best solutions for your individual requirements together.
index.card1_text: We understand that the primary task of an IT department is usually maintenance. The focus is therefore on supporting users and keeping day-to-day processes in the company running smoothly. These processes are critically important, as they are responsible for production, sales, customer acquisition and quality assurance. The time available for professional management of security services is often limited. If this sounds like your situation, or if you simply need support with IT security or server administration, we are happy to help. Contact us and we will prepare a tailored offer to tackle these challenges and improve security in your company.
index.card2_text: The challenges faced by companies and IT departments are directly tied to business requirements. Responding optimally to specific needs requires extensive knowledge and experience, and this approach minimizes potential errors. Our projects are characterized by proven, practical functionality. We can tailor solutions not only to their expected functions, but also to your budget and future development. This saves you time and improves cost efficiency. Our customers particularly appreciate our tailor-made projects. See our expertise for yourself.
index.card3_text: We take a neutral look at your IT structure. Our review shows whether everything is built according to proven standards. We then prepare a report and explain our assessment. We take a close look at the network, firewall settings, user authentication, servers and backups. The goal is clear information: we find security gaps and show where weaknesses exist that could be exploited in an attack. We also give tips for optimizing your existing environment. The best result: you gain certainty that your IT infrastructure is secure. Would you like to try us out? You are welcome to request a security check.
index.training_intro: We train IT professionals with a practical focus - including a compressed 24-month retraining program to become an IT specialist (Fachinformatiker) in system integration.
index.module2: Windows Server, Active Directory & Entra (4 days)
index.support_text: Electronic training record and regular learning-progress diagnostics - from the initial assessment and monthly talks to quarterly reviews and exam simulations. The training is personally supervised by Thomas Karzelek.
index.business_intro: We combine an initial check with continuous monitoring and strong partnerships to give companies of any size a realistic view of their IT security.
index.check_text1: Our IT security check analyzes your IT environment automatically and non-invasively across 9 categories - including email security, outdated applications, GDPR compliance, network and web security, certificates and data breaches. The check follows recognized standards such as NIST CIS, BSI baseline protection, OWASP and GDPR. The result: a consolidated security score, a management summary and a personal review meeting with concrete recommendations.
index.check_text2: On request, we continue to monitor your IT environment - with a scan interval from daily to quarterly and automatic alerts for new vulnerabilities. Our team supports you directly with remediation.
index.partner_text: As a partner of LocateRisk, we also offer business partner risk management: the IT security and compliance of your suppliers and partners is assessed, including questionnaire templates for NIS2, DORA, TISAX and ISO 27001 - important for companies that need to secure their entire supply chain.
